name: iBasso
_terms_not_concluded: Measured 2026-11-25. ibasso.com has no terms page: /terms/, /terms-of-use/, /terms-and-conditions/, /legal/, /privacy/, /copyright/ and /disclaimer/ all return 404, and no header or footer link offers one. The site's only policy document, https://ibasso.com/policies/, was READ IN FULL - Privacy, Sale, Shipping, Return and Warranty - and carries no clause on copying, reproducing, reusing or redistributing content, and no intellectual-property clause at all. Its only sentence touching specifications is about volatility, not reuse: « Merchandise, product specifications, availability, images and prices are subject to change without notice. » The one assertion of rights anywhere is the plain-text footer « Copyright 2026 (c) iBasso Rights Reserved. » robots.txt is « User-agent: * / Crawl-Delay: 20 », with no Disallow, and the delay was honoured. So: no permission found, no prohibition found, and the document a prohibition would live in does not exist. A bare « Rights Reserved » is not a clearance.
_why_no_record_ZERO_TEXT: iBasso publishes no specification text at all. 27 product pages were fetched and parsed - every current player and dongle plus DC05, DC06, DC03Pro, DC04Pro, DX240, DX260 and DX300MAX - and the description block of each contains between 918 and 11 886 characters of markup, 9 to 21 images, and ZERO lines of text. The short-description field is an empty string on all 27. There is no attribute table; the only product attribute exposed is Color. A token sweep over the raw HTML of all 27 pages found none of CS43198, ES9, AK4, DSD, oversampl, coaxial, optical, SPDIF, DoP, USB DAC, Sample Rate or kHz on a single page. Every img alt is empty or the string « iBasso Audio ». Nothing leaks into captions, JSON-LD or meta tags. The only numeral in the markup, 768, is a WordPress srcset width. This is not a thin harvest, it is a null one: a text ingest of ibasso.com yields zero fields for zero devices.
_the_images_were_NOT_read: No number was taken from any image, and none should be inferred from this note. The reader located the files and refused to read them, which is the correct order: a figure transcribed from a picture has a different provenance from a figure quoted from a page, and the catalogue has no source kind for it yet. Older pages number their description images sequentially and the spec sheet sits in the stack - DC07PRO is /wp-content/uploads/2024/07/DC07pro-en_01.jpg through _15.jpg, all 790 px wide - so a transcription pass has somewhere to start. Pages built from 2025 onward serve opaque names like 2026-11-24777.webp behind lazy-loaded placeholders, so on those the spec image cannot even be identified by filename. Also measured: /downloads/ holds firmware and Windows USB-DAC drivers and NO manuals or PDF datasheets, which removes the one text source that would have avoided the question. The drivers do establish that a USB DAC function exists on the DC series and on D16 and TAIPAN, without stating any ceiling.
_two_brands_now_sit_behind_the_same_wall: HiFi ROSE and iBasso both publish their entire specification as pictures. That is a THIRD kind of unharvestable brand beside the refusers and the unreachable, and unlike those two it is not a legal or a network problem - the pages are public, permitted as far as anyone can tell, and legible to a human. What it costs is decided by a method choice nobody has made: whether this catalogue accepts a value transcribed from an image, recorded as such, at a source weight of its own. Until that is decided, every maker who sells through pictures is invisible to the base, and that is a large and growing part of the Chinese portable market.
